numbers.naming_rule: cluster 이름 = member point 의 MuJoCo segmentation body 다수결. point 는 FusedPointCloud.representative -> obs_camera/obs_uv 로 원래 pixel 까지 되짚었다. apple/banana/orange/pear/crate/table 은 그 body 이름, base 후손 링크와 *_target marker 는 robot, 그 밖은 unknown

task_phase_rule.rule: approach = gripper open and seq < first_closed; grasp = closed and apple lift <= 20 mm; transport = closed and lifted and apple<->crate xy > 100 mm; place = closed and lifted and xy <= 100 mm; retreat = open after reopen
